summary.headline: Theft Divination and Lunar Aspects
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 253–265 on theft divination, identifying a thief’s sex, age, appearance, location, distance, road, family, and recovery of stolen goods, followed by lunar void-of-course, lunar-node applications, lunar configurations in the zodiac, and stellar aspects by trine, opposition, sextile, and square. Cross-references cite Mediolano, Vindobonese, Venetian codices, and a Catalan edition; Hermes appears in a theft example.
